description: Free. FEMA National Risk Index for the county of one of the 30 largest U.S. cities: overall rating and score, every hazard's share of the risk, rating, score and expected annual loss, plus (for verified cities) the federal disaster declarations and the official emergency alert sign-up. Omit city for the list. Every result names its source; FEMA rates counties, not cities.

city.description: City id (e.g. dallas, new-york-city), city name or 5-digit county FIPS. Omit to list all 30.

title: Natural-hazard risk for a U.S. city
